disjointness.compared: set equality on full identifiers, never a count
disjointness.why_not_the_universe_block_alone: the universe rung is frozen by V1's `build_universe`, which computes three proofs under V1's own names. This chain declares seven. Calling `disjointness_from` on that block refuses on a domain mismatch -- correctly, and only after the whole cohort has been diffed.

INVARIANT_2_identity_fold_remains_identi.population: fold classes x cohort texts, plus the fold fixtures

INVARIANT_3_expectation_is_independent.population: the oracle module set, exercised over every resolved pair
INVARIANT_3_expectation_is_independent.signature: (before: 'Any', after: 'Any', *, channels: 'dict[str, bool]', ignored: 'frozenset[str]' = frozenset()) -> 'dict[str, dict[str, str]]'

INVARIANT_5_never_silently_unchanged.declared_gap: production has no fail-closed behaviour for an absent fingerprint on the non-CONTENT facets; those observations are counted here, never recorded as unchanged, and never counted as evidence that the channel works. See the frozen protocol's unresolved_fail_closed.
INVARIANT_5_never_silently_unchanged.population: the oracle's 72-combination domain, plus every facet observation

INVARIANT_6_ambiguous_identity_stays_unr.population: identity_unresolved records (a, b) and the effective identity surface (c, d, e); each clause's denominator reported apart
INVARIANT_6_ambiguous_identity_stays_unr.why_five_clauses: V1 implemented (a) and (b). V2R3 added (c), (d) and (e) over one EffectiveSurface after V2R2 died on two separately computed surfaces that required and forbade the same record. All five are graded here; none is reimplemented.

allowed_delta.no_wildcards: every declaration is an exact path. There is no /invariants/*, no /cohort/*, no /execution/*, and `_require_no_delta_reaches_the_core` proves at import that none overlaps the core.
allowed_delta.not_identical_and_does_not_claim_to_be: V2R3 -> V2R3R1 carried the SAME UNSCORED 300 pairs forward, so exact scientific equality was both true and required there. V2R4 is a fresh cohort under a fresh protocol id with full-eight grading, so exact equality is neither. `v2r3r1_semantics.py` is preserved untouched as evidence for the carry-forward decision it was built for.

added: DECLARED_INVARIANT_SET == GRADED_INVARIANT_SET == RECEIPT_INVARIANT_SET, compared as SET EQUALITY on full identifiers in both directions. Not a count: eight wrong names must fail
every declared disjointness population is proved present and holding, compared as set equality against the declared population list
pass_rule.compared_as: a set of clause texts, never positionally

renamed.to: every declared invariant's verdict is MET
renamed.why: the count becomes the DECLARED SET, which the domain-equality clause makes precise. Strictly stronger: 'all eight' is satisfied by eight wrong names, 'every declared' is not.

exclusion_domain.compared: set equality on full identifiers, never a count

invariant_domain.compared: set equality on full identifiers, never on a count
invariant_domain.graded_domain_obtained_by: executing the grading function on a null population and reading the keys it emitted -- not by reading a constant declared beside it

protocol_binding.checked: the protocol file still hashes to what rung 1 sealed, its link to the frame rung in force is intact, and every attestation stem it declares has a writer and a verifier wired here

root_disjointness.screened_at_container_level_too: the git identity tuple carries a prefix, so the same repository under a different subtree reads as a different identity. Candidates were screened on owner/repo before being probed, which is STRICTER than this identity comparison and is what the frame records.

sfi3_separation.decided_on: container identity only; no root on either side was expanded
sfi3_separation.the_replacement_pool_is_inside_the_reser: a container that is only a replacement candidate is still reserved. SFI3 may land there after an availability failure, and a V2R4 root sitting in the pool would silently narrow SFI3's escape route.
sfi3_separation.why_a_reservation_and_not_a_cohort_compa: SFI3's cohort does not exist and must not until V2R4 passes, because SFI3's freeze gate is downstream of MIGRATION_CLOSURE_ACCEPTANCE_V1. Requiring INVARIANT_8 to prove disjointness from SFI3 MATERIAL made a circular gate whose only exits were forbidden: open SFI3 early, or let the invariant pass vacuously over a population that is empty because it cannot yet be non-empty (INC-V2-036). Container identity is decidable now; a cohort comparison is not.
sfi3_separation.wikipedia_is_refused_not_reported_clean: reservation membership for encyclopedia_wikipedia is by category and is not decidable from identity metadata. The reservation REFUSES the family rather than reporting it disjoint, and V2R4 excludes it. 'We could not tell' and 'they do not overlap' are different answers.

spent_disjointness.independent_of_the_enumerator: the enumerator subtracts these sets during admission and this proof does not read its output. A filter and a proof written as one piece of code agree by construction and prove nothing.
spent_disjointness.read_for: lineage ids only. No predecessor's verdict, invariant outcome, violation count or adjudication is read here.
spent_disjointness.why_four_and_not_two: V2R3's list names v2r1 and v2r2 because those were the only spent cohorts when it was written. V2R3's 300 were carried forward unscored into V2R3R1 and MEASURED there, so they are spent for V2R4 -- and they are the nearest and most recently drawn material in the programme. A proof that omitted them would report `holds` while never looking at the cohort most likely to overlap.
